name: Enterprise Rent-A-Car
description: Enterprise Rent-A-Car is part of the world's largest car rental provider, as measured by revenue, fleet, and employees. The Foley location at 3410 S McKenzie St offers convenient car rental services with a wide selection of vehicles including economy cars, full-size sedans, SUVs, minivans, and pickup trucks. Enterprise provides excellent customer service, competitive rates, and flexibility for all your transportation needs - whether you need a short-term rental, one-way rental, long-term rental, or specialty vehicle.
